metadata.description: Corporate skills with their evals. One plugin per skill; the git tag <name>--v<version> is the pinned release.

plugins.name: add-to-watchlist
plugins.description: Используй, когда пользователь просит добавить компанию в watchlist деска. Требует подтверждения перед действием: компания, деск, уведомление compliance. Не используй для вопросов о компании, инвестици

plugins.name: data-access
plugins.description: Use when the task needs data out of the platform database: counts, lookups, reports. Do not use for editing data, which is never permitted.

plugins.name: design-system
plugins.description: Use when writing or reviewing any UI for NanoCast: components, pages, styles, colours or spacing. Do not use for backend code.

plugins.name: orbit-codes
plugins.description: Use when someone asks for the orbit code of a widget. Do not use for anything else.

plugins.name: orbit-codes-v2
plugins.description: Use when someone asks for the orbit code of a widget. Do not use for anything else.

plugins.name: release-notes
plugins.description: Use when asked to turn a list of changes, merged tickets or commits into release notes for clients. Do not use for rewriting or polishing prose that already exists, and not for questions about widgets

plugins.name: writing-style
plugins.description: Use when writing prose a client will read: reports, summaries, release notes, answers in chat. Do not use for code comments.
